# Draft:The Republic of Aminoac

Republic of Aminoac: Overview
Aminoac, officially the Republic Republic of Aminoac(RRA), is a country in Middle East. With a population of approximately 11 million, with about 17.4% of them being Igdelamians. Aminoac is located north of Kazakhstan and South of Russia. The country is divided into 6 cities: Iziaziboaix, Ngiboacow, Izehiacuij, and the city of Ibashin. Ibashin is the country's capital, located at the heart of Aminoac.
Ami and Noac
The ancient Aminoac people (Aminoas) were formed around the sixth century BC and concentrated in the lowlands along the Caspian Sea (Gnauhiahil).
The early Aminoac civilization was a semi-agricultural and semi-nomadic civilization, and the ethnic society was a tribal society. This social state lasted until the first century BC, until the Shuyi period, after the establishment of the main king system (Nauyihc Ehgnot Gnawuhz).
The early Aminoac people were divided into two parts by modern day Aminoas archaeologists. The part living in the lowlands along the Caspian Sea (Gnauhiahil) was called the Ami (UzAmi-Gna.), and the part living in the Tulan Plain (Naugnip Tulan) was called the Noac (UzNoac-NT.)
In the Holy book of Imijah, the Ami and Noac came from the North Star. Because of their heinous crimes, they were abandoned to the desert by the Holy Lord Umah. When the Aminoas landed in the desert, they were punished by Umah, and countless people died due to natural disasters and wide-spread famine.
